class.name: SimpleTerrain3D
class.description: [SimpleTerrain3D] renders and edits a [SimpleTerrainData] height field. The node splits terrain geometry into chunks so renderer culling and brush mesh rebuilds can operate on smaller regions. The inherited [member MeshInstance3D.mesh] is kept empty; terrain chunks are submitted as internal [RenderingServer] instances. All methods and properties listed in this class are registered through ClassDB, so they can be used from GDScript, C#, editor tools, and the Inspector. A typical runtime setup creates a [SimpleTerrain3D], adjusts [member grid_size], [member cell_size], and [member chunk_size], then calls [method reset_flat_terrain] or [method generate_random_terrain]. [codeblock] var terrain := SimpleTerrain3D.new() terrain.grid_size = 128 terrain.cell_size = 1.0 terrain.chunk_size = 32 terrain.use_builtin_triplanar_material = true terrain.reset_flat_terrain() add_child(terrain) [/codeblock] For saved or shared terrain data, assign [member simple_terrain_data] to a [SimpleTerrainData] resource. For visual debugging in the editor, enable [member show_chunk_gizmos].

method.name: apply_brush
method.description: Applies a terrain brush at [param world_position]. The brush affects vertices inside [param radius] and rebuilds only touched chunks. This method is available at runtime, so gameplay code can modify terrain without using the editor toolbar.

method.name: apply_brush_with_delta
method.description: Applies a terrain brush like [method apply_brush] and returns compact undo data. The returned dictionary contains [code]indices[/code], [code]before[/code], and [code]after[/code] arrays for vertices that changed.

method.name: apply_height_patch
method.description: Applies explicit height values to the vertices listed in [param indices] and rebuilds only the affected chunks. This is primarily used by editor undo/redo to avoid storing or restoring the full height field after each brush stroke.

method.name: generate_random_terrain
method.description: Generates a deterministic random height field using [member random_seed], [member random_frequency], [member random_octaves], and [member random_height_scale]. Use [method randomize_seed] when a new seed is desired.

method.name: get_brush_hit
method.description: Intersects a ray against the terrain surface. The returned dictionary contains [code]position[/code] and [code]distance[/code] when a hit is found. The ray is tested with a grid traversal algorithm instead of checking every terrain triangle.

method.name: get_chunk_debug_lines
method.description: Returns line segments that outline terrain chunk boundaries in local space. This is primarily used by the editor gizmo, but can also be consumed by custom debug drawing tools.

method.name: randomize_seed
method.description: Chooses a new random seed and calls [method generate_random_terrain].

method.name: rebuild_mesh
method.description: Rebuilds all terrain chunk meshes from [member simple_terrain_data]. Call this after making many direct changes to [member SimpleTerrainData.height_data] if those changes did not go through [SimpleTerrain3D]'s setters.

method.name: reset_flat_terrain
method.description: Fills [member simple_terrain_data] using [member flat_height] and rebuilds the terrain. This is the default recommended initialization path for a blank editable terrain.

members.member: World-space distance between neighboring terrain vertices. Increasing this makes the terrain cover more space without increasing vertex count.
Number of terrain quads per render chunk. Smaller values create more chunks, which can improve culling granularity but increase chunk management overhead.
Height used by [method reset_flat_terrain].
Number of terrain quads per axis. The terrain stores [member grid_size] + [code]1[/code] vertices per axis.
Convenience proxy to [member SimpleTerrainData.height_data]. Setting this property normalizes the array size and rebuilds terrain chunks.
Material applied to internal terrain chunks. If this is assigned, it takes precedence over [member use_builtin_triplanar_material] and [member GeometryInstance3D.material_override].
Normal-based blend sharpness used by the built-in triplanar material.
Height range used to blend between built-in triplanar material layers.
Color multiplier for the high height layer.
Height where the high layer starts to blend in.
Albedo texture for the high height layer.
Color multiplier for the low height layer.
Height where the low layer starts to blend into the middle layer.
Albedo texture for the low height layer.
Color multiplier for the middle height layer.
Albedo texture for the middle height layer.
World-space texture scale used by the built-in triplanar material. Higher values repeat textures more frequently.
If [code]true[/code], internal chunks use a generated height-based triplanar shader material unless [member terrain_material] is assigned.
Base frequency used by [method generate_random_terrain].
Height multiplier used by [method generate_random_terrain].
Number of noise octaves used by [method generate_random_terrain].
Seed used by [method generate_random_terrain].
If [code]true[/code], the editor gizmo draws chunk boundaries in the 3D viewport.
Resource containing the editable height field. Assign a saved [SimpleTerrainData] resource to reuse terrain across scenes or keep height data independent from the node.
